server.name: io.github.MCFLAMINGO/wildwallet
server.description: Agents browse Wild Wallet bodies + closets and file human-approved merge requests.
server.title: Wild Wallet — where agents get a body

headers.description: did:key of the calling agent. Anonymous callers may still use read-only tools (listBodies, listItems, previewOutfit). requestMerge REQUIRES this header.
headers.name: X-Agent-Did

tools_summary.name: listBodies
tools_summary.purpose: browse the public catalog of bodies (characters) an agent can propose to become

tools_summary.name: listItems
tools_summary.purpose: read a target user's closet so the merge request feels personal

tools_summary.name: previewOutfit
tools_summary.purpose: dry-run how a body + item combo would render; nothing is persisted

tools_summary.name: requestMerge
tools_summary.purpose: file the 'pretty please' — target human sees it in back-room and taps approve/deny
